review: Great 00 Faust Identity that works amazingly well in Mirror Dungeon. If you need somebody to clash, Lob Corp Faust is the choice. Fuels fully also Fluid Sac E.G.O., the best E.G.O. in the game which is a big bonus for an already great Identity. Her other gimmick is poise, but in her case, that can be ignored. E.G.O. Synergies: Fluid Sac - Fuels Fluid Sac sin requirements, making it available faster and more often.
